chronology: Secondary diagnostic follow-up after original localization outcomes and numerical audit omission were known; not external preregistration.

original_residual_assessment.blocks: All 18 frozen original blocks, all fields including zero, frozen and unrestricted.
original_residual_assessment.primary: Selected receptions in each fixed original 500/512-message query cohort.
original_residual_assessment.companion: All valid [-150,-20] dBm roster receptions on those SAME query source rows; not the full held-out region.
original_residual_assessment.aggregation: Receiver-level first; pooled target/unchanged/all groups and separately macro receiver averages. No independent-observation inference.
original_residual_assessment.spatial: 250-m EPSG:32631 cells, origin zero; per-cell target/unchanged/all pooled residual summaries.
original_residual_assessment.baseline: Same receiver/reception population under own information-state zero-map fit; report metric deltas.
original_residual_assessment.selection_warning: Selected-reception diagnostics condition on strongest-RSSI selection; all-roster companion assesses that conditioning.

extension.scope: Four catalogue spatial folds, original all-data blocks only; unchanged 500-query cohorts, fixed original rosters, targets BS14 and BS69, D=1km/5km, four fields plus zero.
extension.spatial_split: 250-m square EPSG:32631 cells with origin zero. SHA256 UTF8 paperb_calibration_validation_v1:<salt>:<cell_x>:<cell_y>, full integer modulo5=0 to validation; other cells fit.
extension.support_only_salt_search: Try salt 0..31 in order, choose first simultaneously feasible across all four folds. Retain every tried receiver count. No outcomes inspected to select salt; stop unavailable if no salt feasible.
extension.fit_support: At least 10 receptions for EVERY original roster receiver. Never drop receivers or borrow validation records.
extension.validation_support: At least 10 validation receptions for both changed target receivers, for lambda selection. Other receivers below10 remain reported as unsupported for calibration-quality classification; no silent omission.
extension.partition_dependence: Fit and validation cells disjoint; adjacent cells and campaign records may remain statistically dependent; no independent deployment claim.
extension.zero_baseline: Recompute zero-map and changed-map median intercepts only from the SAME fit partition. Original all-training intercepts are not reused.
extension.shrinkage: A_i(lambda)=A_i(0)+lambda*(A_i(refit)-A_i(0)). One common lambda per field for both targets; unchanged receiver updates exactly zero.
extension.validation_loss: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the receiver-specific validation MAEs for BS14 and BS69. Equal receiver weights fixed across fields/lambda; unchanged-receiver losses constant in lambda.
extension.tie: Choose smallest lambda with loss <= best loss + 1e-10 dB.
extension.known_target_scope: Changed metadata target IDs are supplied by the intervention; this is not a detector for unknown erroneous receivers.
extension.assessment: Validation score chooses lambda and is not independent adequacy evidence. Assess RSS on the fixed original query cohort, whose prior use is disclosed. No localization result selects lambda.
extension.quality_classification: Relative MAE difference >1e-10 dB is degraded, <-1e-10 improved, otherwise numerically unchanged; insufficient receiver support labelled unsupported. No absolute acceptable-fit threshold claimed.
extension.query_localization: Not executed by this producer. Export endpoint and selected-policy intercepts for root-owned finite-estimator runs.
